name: Remove Curse
description:
You touch one creature or object and end all curses affecting it. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner’s attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

Describe how your remove the curse.

improvements.name: Freedom of Movement
improvements.description: You may also remove any effects from a creature that are currently reducing its Speed or inhibiting its movement. If it is bound by mundane restraints or is grappled, it may spend 5 ft of movement on its next turn to escape.
